title: coins: Optimal strategies in the all-heads coin game
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization verifying every numbered result, numerical experiments (Python computing the optimal winning probability via the exact Bellman recursion), and LaTeX source accompanying the paper "Optimal strategies in the all-heads coin game" by Peter Pfaffelhuber.
